correctness.rationale: The published Theorem 4 basis and equation (4.1) give the degree-three \(U/W/V\) decomposition and local braid correction. Each \(N_{ij}\) kills \(U\) and \(V\) and maps \(W\) to \(V\), so all products \(N_{ij}N_{kl}\) vanish. The sum of all \(N_{ij}\) cancels on every \(W\) basis vector. Restricting any relation to any three labels yields exactly the published \(P_3\) rank-two local relation, hence the three edge coefficients are equal; this propagates to all edges. The checker independently verifies the matrix identities through \(n=8\). Risk: cellular orientation choices may change signs but not the rank or relation module.
